episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the potential transformation of Zillow into a major brokerage and the implications of the 21st Century Road to Housing Act on the real estate market. He explores the evolving role of AI in real estate and how agents can create unique value by focusing on niche markets and lifestyle-based services. The conversation provides insights into the future dynamics of indie brokerages versus large corporations.
